items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: that's the first time I heard Minor Hall play. Yeah he was with the band also, later on.

ctx.x: Who did Dave play with in the old days when you heard him? Oh I played with different guys.

I remember he was with, what's the name of that band, I think it was Crescent City, Crescent City band, yeah. He was with that band for a while and that's the first time I heard Minor Hall play. Yeah he was with the band also, later on. Was that a brass band? No. No they was playing an advertisement, six pieces, Dixieland band.
